text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Into the final stretch!!
The Umamusume unleash their final spurts!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I won't give it up...!!
Today, I'm gonna seize it!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(At Tokyo Racecourse, where Ai-san showed me her power!
With the pride to become the "Queen"!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's Lucky Lilac!!!
Lucky Lilac is in the lead!!
Across the finish line!!!"

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"A complete victory for Lucky Lilac, even at a mile!!
This year's Queen of Spring is Lucky Lilac!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What an angle of attack...!
Lala's strength has gotten even sharper...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to lose. I need to come up with a counterstrategy...!
So that I can win the next time we compete!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky Lilac is super strong in the mile too!
No doubt about it, she's top-tier among this era's Tiara Umamusume!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“When you think about it, isn't that only natural?
I mean, Lucky Lilac was crowned queen
even earlier than Almond Eye, you know.”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Yes. This is it. The confidence welling up from within—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (It's the pride that makes me want to hold my head high as a "Queen," that strengthens my heart...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Still... it's not enough yet.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...That's one down, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's a huge step forward...!

text_block_list.text:
And so, Lucky Lilac proved her strength in the mile,
earning a solid sense of pride she could hold in her hands—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, this year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup is being held at Hanshin Racecourse, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Right, due to maintenance at Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.text:
Venues changing due to racecourse circumstances
had occasionally happened in the past as well.

"Holding it at a different venue than usual means
we'll need that many new countermeasures, but—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Right after the Osaka Hai, too... Feels like fate, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: When I'm in the zone, the pace and everything else just naturally falls into place for me—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to this, I feel like I can head into
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup in great spirits.
choice_data_list: Looks like it's going to be a glorious triumphant return

text_block_list.text:
To become the "Queen" once more at Hanshin Racecourse, where she conquered the Hanshin JF and became the Junior Queen.
As a story of resurgence, there could be nothing better.
choice_data_list: It's a little while until fall, but let's keep at it

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. From here on out, even more so.
So that we can bloom proudly, true to ourselves.

To solidify that throne,
her march toward the Queen Elizabeth II Cup continues—
